title: [Claude] Data race on stb_ds global hash seed between JS and main threads
body:
## Problem
ThreadSanitizer (run manually while building the #58 harnesses, PR #77) reports a race on stb_ds's global `stbds_hash_seed`: both the JS thread and the main thread write it when they create hash maps. Lock-free writes to a shared seed are undefined behaviour and can make two threads hash the same key differently.

## Fix
Call `stbds_rand_seed` (or otherwise initialise the seed) once at startup before any thread starts, and make sure no later code path re-seeds. Consider wiring the TSan run into the sanitized CI step once it is clean.

Posted by Claude Code [claude-fable-5-1]
